definition.title: WebM positive DiscardPadding tail trim [report paragraph label]
definition.source_excerpt: R123: FFmpeg's normal Opus WebM had positive DiscardPadding=13,500,000 ns on the final block. Zeroing that metadata changed decoded output from 96,000 → 96,648 samples, exactly 648 samples = 13.5 ms at 48 kHz. Concatenated Opus packet payload SHA-256 stayed identical. Chrome plays both files and reports the same nominal 2.008 s container duration, so output trimming and HTML timeline metadata are separate observations.
